description: Short synthetic documents, four or five per kind in the default cue pack plus four that should get no kind. Labelled by hand when the set was written (UW-13); file names carry no cue, so only the content decides.

cases.text:
# Certificate of Insurance

This is to certify that Asha Rao holds policy P-9 with Example Mutual.

Valid until 31 March 2027.

# Certificate of Incorporation

I hereby certify that Example Traders Private Limited is incorporated under the Companies Act.

Date of issue: 4 June 2019.

Certificate number FC-2231. Valid from 1 April 2026.

# Leave Policy

Employees must apply for leave five days in advance. Managers shall approve requests within two days.

The handler is required to verify policy status before processing. Claims may not be closed without a review.

Staff must book economy class. Expenses above 10,000 are not permitted without approval.

The customer shall pay within 30 days. Refunds are not permitted after delivery.

The parties agree to keep confidential information secret. Effective date: 5 March 2026.
